name: fitness-transformation-glowup
title: Fitness Before/After Transformation
format_summary: A two-shot before-and-after sequence showing a physique transformation, driven by a hard cut and a trending audio track.

after_state.value: about 15 kg lighter after 3 months of training: much narrower waist, completely flat stomach with visible ab lines and obliques, lean toned arms with defined shoulders, slimmer face and sharper jawline, upright confident posture
after_state.description: Every visible change for the 'after' edit (written as a delta).

before_state.value: visibly out of shape and carrying roughly 15 kg of extra weight: a soft rounded lower belly that spills slightly over the waistband, soft love handles, thick soft upper arms, fuller round face and soft jawline, no muscle definition anywhere, relaxed slightly slouched posture
before_state.description: Visible 'before' body — concrete, so the model doesn't default to a fit person.

caption_text.value: watch me lock in for 3 months
caption_text.description: Hook text displayed in the first shot.

character.value: East Asian woman in her mid 20s, dark hair in a messy high bun, black sports bra and loose black shorts, skin shiny with sweat
character.description: Base description of the person and outfit.

setting_after.value: bathroom with glass shower door and white subway tiles

setting_before.value: bathroom with shower curtain and wooden shelves

steps.prompt: Vertical iPhone photo, side profile, full torso to mid-thigh in frame. {{character}}. Her body is {{before_state}}. She stands in {{setting_before}}. Warm dim bathroom light, slight grain, casual UGC mirror-check look, no text.
steps.why: Best for generating realistic UGC human subjects with accurate prompt adherence.

steps.prompt: Same woman: keep her exact face, hair bun, black sports bra and black shorts, same side-profile camera framing. She is now {{after_state}}. Make the transformation dramatic and obvious at a glance — do NOT keep any of the old belly, love handles or soft arms. Move her to {{setting_after}}. Bright overhead bathroom light, vertical iPhone UGC look, no text.
steps.why: Identity-preserving edit written as an explicit delta, so the after body actually changes instead of copying the before.

steps.prompt: She slowly turns from side profile toward the camera and back, letting her soft belly and arms show. Static handheld phone camera, natural pace. Her body shape stays exactly the same the whole shot.
steps.why: Kling handles slow, deliberate human rotations well without losing structural integrity.

steps.prompt: She gives two thumbs up, then turns sideways and stretches both arms straight out in front, showing her flat stomach and lean arms. Static handheld phone camera. Her lean body shape stays exactly the same the whole shot.
steps.why: Strong at complex human gestures like thumbs up and arm extensions.
